items.text: Marine biotechnology careers cover aquaculture health, marine natural products, algae cultivation, marine microbiology and bioprospecting, and they combine lab skill with field and sea or coastal work under strict permit and biodiversity rules.
Learn marine biology and microbiology basics, gain coastal or lab exposure and document one small cultivation or screening project.
Verify rules and avoid ventures that ignore them.
